name: JailbreakBench/jailbreakbench
description: Open robustness benchmark for evaluating jailbreaking attacks and defenses in LLMs, published at NeurIPS 2024. Provides standardized threat models, the JBB-Behaviors dataset of 200 behaviors, and an official leaderboard for tracking attack and defense progress.
score_rationale: NeurIPS 2024 standardized LLM jailbreak benchmark with 556 stars that provides the most widely used evaluation framework for LLM robustness research.
summary: Open robustness benchmark for evaluating jailbreaking attacks and defenses in LLMs, published at Neu
